challenges.title: Exchanging a clothing size without receipt
challenges.shortDescription: Handle a customer wanting to exchange shirt size without original receipt.
challenges.mission: Check store exchange policy, verify item condition, and offer alternative exchange options.

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: getting the right size without losing money

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Explains they received it as a gift and lost the receipt.
unacceptablePromises: Do not promise cash refund without receipt.
